items.comments: It's a spacious and quiet place. Close to shops and restaurants. Nice stay.

The host let me know what to expect on the day I arrive (eg: a hackathon) so there were lots of people around, which was cool. I was in and out quite a bit so I met up with the host towards the end of the day when I was all settled in. The listing is basically accurate, right by University of Washington and pretty much one of the more convenient/quiet locations.
